Messages.Author: Jadasc
Messages.Body:
Searching through the rulings shows me that, if Withering is played at
THN with first strike (via Shadow Feint, say), the opposing minion
still gets to play a discipline-based strike card. My question is
about the inferior level: if Withering is played at thn at first
strike, and the opposing minion makes a hand strike, is that strike at
-1 strength, or not?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


-1 strength. It resolves before the other strike begins to resolve.
